answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer joins at dawn with a 20-unit stake and a public log. Five auditors check it across a ridge of tasks; a pass trades on, a fail loses the stake. A comet of copied logs fails, since five auditors rarely share one blind spot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 units, far above diluted rewards. An honest agent pays one stake, recovers it after 10 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
